title: 12-Acre Nashville Retreat | Sleeps 12 | Game Room
description: Escape to The Darby House, a peaceful 12-acre retreat just 30 minutes from Nashville! Perfect for families & groups, this spacious 4BR/3BA getaway sleeps 12 with a king suite, 2 queen rooms, 4 twin beds, & a sleeper sofa. Challenge the crew in the game room with air hockey, arcade games & more, then unwind on the deck, fire up the grill & soak in the peaceful country views. Fast Wi-Fi + a fully equipped kitchen make it easy to settle in and stay awhile!
